UNIVERSAL.changelog:
Version 0.0.4 — one version number for both boards

Both JBoards firmwares now carry the same version number and ship as one
release. Until now the ESP32-P4 and the PocketBeagle 2 were numbered
independently and published as separate entries, so the same product could be
0.0.3 on one board and 0.0.108 on the other, and finding the right download
meant knowing which entry belonged to which board. A version is now a single
release holding both boards' files, and "what version are you on?" has one
answer.

The PocketBeagle 2 numbering restarts to match. Boards running one of the old
0.0.10x builds will not be offered this release automatically, because it is a
lower number; those boards need updating once by hand, after which normal update
checks resume.

Downloads are named the same way on both boards, firmware-<board>-<version>, so
the file you are downloading names the board it is for.
